_about: I1 return test, cohort 2026c (wiser/scripts/analyze_wiser_i1_return.py; plan implementation_plan/2026-10-05-wiser-i1-return-test-and-video-review.md Part 1, approved by the user 2026-10-05, committed d722ec0 before any result; operational details in its 'Amendment (Part 1)', written before any number of this step). Does the raw WISER position come back to where it was after a V3 I1 event (return = WISER error) or settle >= 12 in away (relocate = real movement)? Classes, windows, thresholds and the reading are the plan's and must not be changed after a result. Nothing is tuned. The run writes the pre-registered reading into `reading`; --with-verdicts writes the video-verdict agreement into `validation`. A new cohort = a new copy of this file + a re-run.

windows._note: P0 = coordinate-wise median of the unmasked raw fixes with aligned time in [run_t0, run_t0 + 2) (the audit's I1 reference window = first 2 s of the trimmed run); P1 = median of the raw fixes in [t_end, t_end + 10) intersected with the trimmed run, t_end = the audit's event-window end (events.t1); a window is valid iff its length (inside the run) >= 5 s and it holds >= 10 raw fixes, else the event is censored. Sensitivities: S1 pre = [t_onset - 10, t_onset) inside the run (same minimums); S2 post = [t_end, t_end + 30) inside the run (same minimums); S3 run-end (declared in Amendment (Part 1), no rule uses it) = [max(t_onset, run_t1 - 10), run_t1) (same minimums).

classes._note: return ||P1 - P0|| < 6 in; relocate >= 12 in; ambiguous 6-12 in; censored = no valid post window inside the run

bands._note: size = the audit's I1 size (max displacement of the V3 1-s median from its run reference); duration = the audit's dur_s (seconds >= 12 in); run length = trimmed run length (the audit's run-length bins). Lower edges inclusive; dur_s and run_len_s are integer seconds (run_len bins are (a, b] as in the audit's pd.cut).

profile._note: raw 1-s medians (>= 2 fixes, the audit's I1 estimator) on seconds inside the trimmed run, distance to P0; per class median and quartiles over events with a value

reading_rule._note: WISER in-place wandering dominates I1 iff return >= 50 % of the non-censored events AND the return class's <= 6-anchor share ratio (event / matched control) >= 1.5 AND its CI lower bound > 1 AND that CI lower bound > the relocate class's point estimate (grammatical reading of 'with its CI above 1 and above the relocate class's point estimate'; Amendment (Part 1) item 6; the looser 'point > point' is reported for information). An undefined relocate estimate = condition not met. Then propose V8 as a new pre-registered test; otherwise V3 stays, no correction.

verdicts._note: Part-2 export (JSON with `rows`/`judgements` or CSV; Amendment (Part 2) 1 item 7: `verdict_blind` = `verdict` = the first, blind answer - used here; `verdict_final` is ignored): matched to this run's events on (animal, event_id) of V3 I1 (`audit_event_id` or the `event_key` <animal>|V3|<type>|<event_id>), else on (animal, field-PC onset within 1.5 s); verdicts normalised to moved / stayed / cannot_tell; I2 rows ignored. Agreement: return <-> stayed, relocate <-> moved; Cohen's kappa on events with class in {return, relocate} and verdict in {moved, stayed}. Nothing is re-tuned on the verdicts.

reading.plan_label: I1 is mainly real movement the IMU missed
